items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: For although Hochma, which is Mocha Stimaa, was corrected within herself in the manner of male and female and brought Bina, which is the Garon [throat], outside, this does not mean that separate male and female were made in Hochma Stimaa itself, as in AVI who are below the Garon. Rather, it means in the discernment of the Nukva that is in his Guf [body] — that is, in the discernment of the screen of the Rosh [head], as is the practice in the Partzufim of AK as well. Only, since this took place here in the place of Hochma, Bina came out below the discernment of the Rosh. But this in no way touches Mocha Stimaa itself, which is found above this screen, and therefore the male and female are in the aspect of a single Partzuf, like the Partzufim of AK, and there is in them only one YHV. This is not so with AVI who are below the Garon of AA, who are found beneath the screen of the Rosh: there AVI became two Partzufim separate from one another, each of which has male and female in its own Guf. For there is a great difference there between Abba and Ima, since Abba came out in the secret of the Hesed at the tops of the shoulders of AA, while Ima came out from the discernment of the light of the Garon; and Ima is also in a posterior position toward the light of Hochma. They therefore became two distinct Partzufim, and they are two names Ehyeh and not a single name, as is Mocha Stimaa. (Page 935, Item 123).
